title: Korea's National Health Insurance Service says an employee's improper handling of work leaked some customers' personal data
geo_basis: National agency of South Korea; pin at country level
summary: Daily SECU reports that the National Health Insurance Service posted a notice on 25 November saying some customers' personal information was leaked through an employee's improper handling of work. Customers with addresses on file were notified individually; 25 people with no valid contact details were told on the website. Daily SECU says 25 is not the total and the notice gives no total.
plain: Daily SECU reports Korea's health insurer says an employee's improper handling of work leaked some customers' data. The notice gives no total number of people affected.
exec: A national health insurer says an employee's improper handling of work leaked some customer data; the scale is not stated, per Daily SECU.
action: General advice: grant staff only the minimum access rights needed and audit access logs regularly, as Daily SECU suggests.
impact: Some customers' personal information leaked; total and data types not stated in the notice, per Daily SECU.

validation.note: One publisher read (Daily Security), quoting NHIS's website notice; the notice itself was not read.

review.note: exec said not an outside hack, which the source does not say; reworded to source wording. Date, 25 figure, evidence checked against Daily SECU
